name: Native original work and carrier city assets survive return to Free Cities

condition.code:
local stage=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE')
if not stage then return false end
local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y)
local source=CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Source.X,stage.Source.Y)
return city and city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Owner
 and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(stage.Carrier.Building)
 and city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Carrier.Building,stage.Carrier.Slot)==stage.Index
 and source and source:GetOwner()==stage.Source.Owner
 and source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Source.Building,stage.Source.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
local located=A.NativeWorkLocations(stage.Index)
assert(#located==1 and located[1].Owner==stage.Carrier.Owner and located[1].X==stage.Carrier.X and located[1].Y==stage.Carrier.Y and located[1].Building==stage.Carrier.Building and located[1].Slot==stage.Carrier.Slot,'same-owner move did not put the original work in carrier Temple')
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Owner and city:GetID()==located[1].CityID,'AI carrier identity changed before Free Cities return')
stage.BeforeReturn={CityID=city:GetID(),Population=city:GetPopulation(),Name=city:GetName(),Assets=A.CityAssets(city)}
stage.Stage='RETURNING_FREE'
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE',stage)
CityManager.TransferCity(city,stage.Carrier.Free)
return 'work-holding Temple city returned to Free Cities; physical result still unproven'

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
assert(stage.Stage=='RETURNING_FREE' or stage.Stage=='FREE_CUSTODY_PROVED','carrier return intent absent')
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Free and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(stage.Carrier.Building),'Free Cities did not retain carrier Temple')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(stage.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==stage.Carrier.Free and found[1].CityID==city:GetID()
 and found[1].X==stage.Carrier.X and found[1].Y==stage.Carrier.Y
 and found[1].Building==stage.Carrier.Building and found[1].Slot==stage.Carrier.Slot,'same original index not uniquely held in Free Cities Temple')
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Source.X,stage.Source.Y))
assert(source:GetOwner()==stage.Source.Owner,'AI original city changed owner')
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
assert(reads.ReadCity(stage.Source.Owner,stage.Source.CityID,'WORK',stage.Source.Building,stage.Source.Slot)==-1,'AI original Palace slot not empty')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(stage.Source[key]==found[1][key],'original work metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(stage.Source.Effects,found[1].Effects),'original work effects changed')
local after={Population=city:GetPopulation(),Name=city:GetName(),Assets=A.CityAssets(city)}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_AI_CARRIER_RETURN_SIDE_EFFECTS] before='..A.Canonical(stage.BeforeReturn)..' after='..A.Canonical(after))
assert(A.Rules.Equal(stage.BeforeReturn.Assets,after.Assets),'carrier districts/buildings/works changed during return to Free Cities')
assert(stage.BeforeReturn.Population==after.Population,'carrier population changed during return to Free Cities')
stage.Stage='FREE_CUSTODY_PROVED';stage.Carrier.FreeCity=city:GetID()
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE',stage)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_AI_CITY_MEDIATED_CUSTODY] '..A.Canonical(stage))
return 'same original work and carrier assets survived return to Free Cities'
